Description: An incompressible swirling-flow visualizer inspired by cylindrical Navier-Stokes velocity fields, viscosity falloff, and vortex cores.
KScript: var radius := sqrt(x*x + y*y) + 0.001; var core := max(v1, 1.0); var swirl := v0 * exp(-(radius*radius)/(core*core)); var angle := t*swirl + u*v2; var c := cos(angle); var s := sin(angle); var ox := x; var oy := y; var radial := (1.0 - exp(-radius/core)) * v3 * sin(t*v4 + u*v5); x := ox*c - oy*s + (ox/radius)*radial; y := ox*s + oy*c + (oy/radius)*radial; z += sin(t*v6 + radius*v7) * v8;

Variables.Name: Vorticity
Variables.Tooltip: Angular velocity at the vortex center

Variables.Name: CoreRadius
Variables.Tooltip: Vortex core radius in Unreal units
